messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up — Beta Retail asked to expand the POC: add streaming summaries + BYO-KMS. Also asked if we can still hit the 2-week POC if we include those.

ivan_se: BYO-KMS adds ops work (VPC peering or proxy, cert exchange) ~48-72h. HSM restrictions can block key export flows. Streaming at scale changes sizing a lot; need their QPS and average tokens/second.

maria_sales: They said peak 140 concurrent streams, ~35 t/s avg.

ivan_se: That implies ~4900 t/s peak. On hosted this will cause autoscale and latency variance. Recommend: 1) short canary (40 concurrent) first week, 2) hosted overflow pricing OR Dedicated reservation for predictable latency.

sophie_security: For BYO-KMS we need KMS architecture doc, IAM policy, and export/HSM constraints. If keys cannot be used outside an HSM, streaming path might be incompatible. Require KMS attestation before tests.

noah_pm: Update acceptance criteria: keep quality eval (>=0.82), add burst test to validate 140 concurrent for 10m, and include KMS attestation as gating.

maria_sales: Customer pushing back on Dedicated cost. Asking for delta on hosted-burst vs minimal dedicated.

ivan_se: Quick guidance: hosted-burst ~+40-50% unit cost under those bursts; minimal Dedicated (196 GPUs sized) ~+150% monthly but stable. I'll drop a sizing snippet they can paste.

maria_sales: Please paste snippet.

ivan_se: ```reserved_pool: 3 gpus
model: rwd-quant-13b
burst_policy:
  overflow: hosted
  max_hosted_instances: 8
```

deploy-bot: POC environment queued by maria_sales  ETA 2.5h (billing pending).

sophie_security: Final: do not start BYO-KMS flows until we confirm attestation + IAM.

maria_sales: I'll ask for KMS docs, 30 sample streaming prompts, and ask them to confirm canary-first approach. Will post reply when I get it. :thumbsup:
